## Introduction & Research Question

## Data Description & Cleaning
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
acs<-read_csv("psam_p55.csv")
glimpse(acs)
```
```{r}
income_data<-acs%>%
  filter(
    AGEP>=18,
    SCHL %in% c("16","21"),
    !is.na(PINCP)
  )
```
#SCHL is a variable means educational attainment
```{r}
income_data%>%
  group_by(SCHL)%>%
  summarize(n=n())
```

## Descriptive Statistics & Visualization
```{r}
income_data%>%
  group_by(SCHL)%>%
  summarize(
    n=n(),
    mean_income=mean(PINCP, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#
income_summary<-income_data%>%
  group_by(SCHL)%>%
  summarize(
    mean_income=mean(PINCP,na.rm=TRUE)
  )
ggplot(income_summary,aes(x=SCHL, y=mean_income))+
  geom_col()
```

## Statistical Inference
### Hypotheses
μB: Population mean annual income for adults with a bachelor's degree.
μH = Population mean annual income for adults with a high school diploma.

H0: μB - μH = 0
This is no difference in mean annual income between the two education groups.

HA: μB - μH ≠ 0
There is a difference in mean annual income between the two education groups.
